_about: Public-domain Johannes Jacobus van Oosterzee (1817-1882, Utrecht) in English for the Word Hoard: Christian Dogmatics, tr. John Watson Watson and Maurice J. Evans (2 vols, 1874), the Theology of the New Testament (1870), Practical Theology (1878) and The Image of Christ (1874), all tr. Evans, the Year of Salvation vol. I, tr. C. Spence, Moses (1876), John's Gospel, tr. J. F. Hurst (1869), and his Commentary on St Luke vol. I in the Lange series, tr. Sophia Taylor (1862), from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-18 by lane A, round 30 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
